title: V5.1 Question Input Package
description: Input package for the V5.1 pipeline: an already-existing question (with optional manual corrections) that enters at Agent 110.

question_id.description: Unique identifier from the 800-question QA JSONL source.

question_text.description: The question text, after manual corrections from issue_registry have been applied.

answer_contract.description: Optional answer contract from the QA source, used for validation.

manual_corrections.description: List of applied corrections from issue_registry.
